personality_one_liner: A high-fashion, editorial-led e-commerce experience where quiet typography and generous whitespace let the clothing and AI try-on feel like a premium magazine.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Use magazine-like spacing rhythms.

do's: Use solid surface blocks or solid fade gradients instead of glass to maintain the raw editorial aesthetic.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism, it clashes with the Editorial paper-like vibe.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the premium AI-styling value proposition and capture user's skin tone via a face photo scan.

states.loading: Centered elegant spinner with 'Analyzing skin tone...'
states.error: Message 'Unable to detect face clearly.' with a 'Retake Photo' button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed editorial imagery. A dark vertical gradient scrim at the bottom over the image to ensure the high-contrast serif title and primary action are clearly readable.

screens.name: Preferences
screens.purpose: Collect budget, occasion, and clothing type preferences using elegant sliders and list selections.
screens.layout: Quiet, text-heavy layout with strong typographic hierarchy. Use `borderStrong` for selected states and hairline `border` for unselected list items. Sticky CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Discover (Home)
screens.purpose: Display personalized clothing recommendations based on skin tone and preferences.

states.empty: Minimalist icon with 'No matches found for this filter.' and a 'Clear Filters' button.
states.error: Message 'Failed to load recommendations' and 'Retry' CTA.

screens.layout: 2-column grid for products with generous `md` gap. Images must stretch to fill their containers without rounded corners (radius 0). Product titles in Sans, prices in Serif. Muted dividers between sections.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Showcase a clothing item in detail with an indicator of how well it matches the user's skin tone palette, leading to Virtual Try-On.
screens.layout: Edge-to-edge product hero image. Title and description below with editorial whitespace. A dedicated 'Palette Match' section highlighting the synergy between the garment color and user's skin tone. Sticky CTA at the bottom to 'Virtual Try-On'.

screens.name: VirtualTryOn
screens.purpose: Upload a full-body photo and preview the AI-generated image of the user wearing the garment.

states.loading: Animated progress text 'Simulating garment...' over the uploaded photo.
states.empty: Prompt to 'Upload a full-body photo' with a chic illustration or placeholder.
states.error: Error message 'Try-on failed. Please try a clearer photo.' and a retry CTA.

screens.layout: Split-screen or side-by-side comparison view. Display a product carousel at the bottom to quickly swap clothing items without leaving the screen. Minimalist, uncluttered interface to keep focus on the generated image.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Editorial Mobile layout: generous whitespace, sharp corners (radius 0), and quiet dividers without shadows.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. This app relies on solid surfaces and stark contrasts to maintain a high-fashion, print-magazine feel.
Ensure all text layered over images uses the mandatory top-to-bottom `expo-linear-gradient` scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
Typography: Never use font weights above 500. Use Playfair Display for dramatic, large headings and Satoshi for all body text, metadata, and controls.
Implement the Virtual Try-On feature as a frictionless flow. Rely on a single full-body photo upload rather than complex measurements, as discovered in the web research.
Use side-by-side or split-screen comparisons for the try-on result, keeping the clothing the focal point by avoiding brightly colored UI chrome.
Always place primary CTAs in a sticky container at the bottom of scrolling views, respecting safe area insets.
